title: Hypercontractive moment gap derivative
statement:
For a finite set $\Omega$, a function $X:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$, and real numbers $p,q,\rho,t$, define the hypercontractive moment gap derivative to be
\[
q\,D_{p,1}(X,t)\,M_{p,1}(X,t)^{q-1}-p\,D_{q,\rho}(X,t)\,M_{q,\rho}(X,t)^{p-1},
\]
where $M_{a,r}(X,t)$ denotes the affine moment with parameters $a,r,X,t$, and $D_{a,r}(X,t)$ its affine moment derivative.
